To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the maximum robustness of flight for a small scale solar powered aircraft is achieved when the battery and photovoltaics mass are equal.
the optimal battery and solar array mass ratio is approximately 2.5:1 and that this aircraft has the potential to achieve robust continuous flight.
the optimal photovoltaic array and battery mass for continuous flight of a solar powered unmanned aerial vehicle is 0.25 kg and 2.5 kg respectively.

the development and optimization of a small unmanned aerial vehicle that can sustain continuous flight for a theoretically unlimited duration.
the design and optimization of a small scale solar powered unmanned aerial vehicle that is capable of sustained flight without the need for a recharge or refuel.
developing an unmanned aircraft that is able to sustain continuous flight for an indefinite period of time.

we present an overview of a small unmanned aircraft capable of continuous flight, metrics that quantify the performance of continuous flight, and optimization criteria to determine the optimal mass for the photovoltaic array and battery.
